text:
alex_marketing: Kicking off SkyGrid marketplace + integration launch ops. Main deliverables: marketplace catalog entry, joint webinar (target May 12), benchmark blog, and inbound lead routing. Triage doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/sprints/skygrid-integration. Need final PDP copy + demo video by EOD Friday.

priya_partners: Got it. SkyGrid wants a 30-min joint webinar (demo + Q&A). We'll do pre-reg landing page. They also want partner UTM on all assets. Who's owning lead field mapping to SFDC?

jonah_sales: I can own lead routing. Requirement: SkyGrid leads go to SFDC lead queue 'SkyGrid' and enter AE rotation. Capture 'deployment_type' and 'region' on the lead. Will share mapping spec later.

mei_content: I can draft the benchmark narrative and the blog. Need access to SkyGrid test account + sample dataset to reproduce numbers. Also need the three benchmark queries we agreed on.

luis_growth: I'll spin up the landing page + pre-reg form in staging. We'll add utm_partner=skygrid hidden field. Webinar time proposal: 9am PT. Calendar draft: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/skygrid-demo (placeholder).

priya_partners: 9am PT works for SkyGrid. They asked us to highlight 'reduced per-token cost by 2.3x' in the narrative — make sure we can back that.

alex_marketing: Quick note on the numbers: 2.3x came from 8k token runs on our dedicated pools using the bf16-quantized variant; 95th perc latency <= 300ms. Mei, can you validate those figures before we publish? Also attach the demo script when ready.

mei_content: I will validate and run an extra replicate. Draft outline for benchmark blog: 1) Problem 2) Test setup (model, quant, hw) 3) Results 4) Actionable takeaways. Aiming for a Wednesday draft.

jonah_sales: Lead routing mapping example (will formalize in a doc):
```
source,utm_partner,lead_queue,assign_to,fields_to_capture
webinar,skygrid,SkyGrid,AE-Rotation,deployment_type|region|integration_use_case
marketplace,skygrid,SkyGrid,AE-Rotation,instance_size|billing_contact
```
We need a webhook to push form submits into SFDC with lifecycle_stage=MQL on registration.

alex_marketing: Speakers: Alex (host), SkyGrid Eng (Sam Lee), SkyGrid PM (Tara Brooks), Redwood product (Mei?). Priya — can you confirm speaker names + headshots this week?

priya_partners: Confirmed Sam Lee (SkyGrid Eng) and Tara Brooks (Head of Partnerships). I'll gather headshots and bios and send co-promo kit by Tue.

luis_growth: Landing page is up in staging (https://staging.redwood.ai/skygrid). Added preliminary copy, registration form, and chat widget for live Qs. Will push updates EOD.

deploybot: deploy-bot: staging site published at 2026-04-08T16:12Z — https://staging.redwood.ai/skygrid

alex_marketing: Content checklist: PDP copy, demo video (5m clip), benchmark blog, landing page, lead mapping doc, co-promo assets. Owners: Mei (blog + numbers), Luis (landing), Jonah (lead mapping + webhook), Priya (partner comms), Alex (overall). Deadlines: Fri for demo + PDP copy; Wed for blog draft.

priya_partners: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate co-promo cadence with SkyGrid marketing (email + social) and confirm their send dates.

jonah_sales: I'll draft the webhook spec for SFDC push and the AE rotation rules. Also will ensure we capture utm_partner and source.

mei_content: Demo script placeholder: 
```text
0:00 intro
1:00 test dataset + setup
2:30 live query demo
5:00 cost + latency charts
6:00 Q&A
```
I'll plug in validated charts once models run completes.

alex_marketing: Nice. Let's do a quick sync Friday 10am PT to review final assets and go/no-go. Thanks everyone.
